provenance_contract.owner: New bounded serializable Forge LevelChunk capability jem_advancements:nature_origin_v4, native Forge capability persistence/lifecycle
provenance_contract.data: Only concrete physical mature-calcite coral origin, anvil placement/release origin and pending projectile-detached Coconut origin, no progress/reward/completion state
provenance_contract.bounds: At most4096 records per kind per loaded native chunk, maximum three kinds. Actual block/state mutations invalidate origins. Loaded getChunkNow access only, no forced chunk loads/scans/timers or ecology changes. Capacity overflow fails proof closed without changing native mechanics.
provenance_contract.save_load: Native Forge ICapabilitySerializable chunk persistence, no separate SavedData journal, no custom chunk codec or block/entity UUID rewrite

transient_contract: At most one Lotus ride and one root clue/target per real online actor. Mutation-indexed target invalidation and logout/death/clone/dimension/server-stop cleanup. Drop scopes are one native call, restored with try/finally.
native_criteria_contract: Root+fruit retain original completed criterion/action for Coconut and AND a new foraged_roots criterion with exact native turnip action. Both stages persist in native advancement. Other four original criteria unchanged. Lotus lift/descent remain one connected native episode.
preserved: All card content/goals/counts/mods/routes/coordinates/rewards/IDs, native random growth/config/loot/physics/control and original native calls, all earlier travel/food/storage/workshop/Create/native/migration owners
limitations: Source is unbuilt and actual Mixin application unobserved
Independent review is deferred to the parent overall pass
Late CoralBlock randomTick method and exact native private column helper require the submitted source-backed Mixin ordering, runtime remains false
Preexisting/decorative Calcite clusters lacking observed native maturity provenance must regrow through native large-bud maturity before this proof can award
Physical provenance beyond4096 entries of one kind in a single chunk is deliberately unproved, native gameplay is unchanged

producers.native_evidence: NatureSpirit2.2.5 LotusFlowerBlock.performBonemeal and LotusStemBlock.grow invoke the actual selected Player.move(SHULKER_BOX, Vec3) once. Observe real post-collision Y gain only for the authenticated survival actor standing on exact native flower geometry, then verify original head became connected stem and next native flower committed. Stem head is the unchanged native getFlowerHeadPos result, not a separate search. Same connected ride must accumulate at least2 native blocks and actual net height. Native flower tick crouch descent is not a movement call: preserve its existing nearest-player gameplay query once, validate returned actor is actual supported crouching rider, verify native upper-head removal/lower-head placement, then require actual downward player movement accepted by vanilla handleMovePlayer. Proximity, bonemeal click and desired movement alone never award.
producers.attribution: Exact native acting player, validated native Lotus rider, owned projectile or proven falling-anvil placement/release actor. Reuses frozen read-only TravelProof.eligible authentication admission.
unsupported_paths: Bonemeal/raw crouch/proximity without actual rider
Jump or desired velocity without native lift
Wrong/disconnected stem, failed head mutation, sideways exit
Native shrink without accepted downward movement

producers.source_acceptance: Combined native-owner source review, compilation and runtime application remain separate
